title: Design: A/P Summary load error message shows in place of the rows
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a vendor with an open bill on today's date, so the report has rows.
  • Make sure you can switch this computer's network connection off and on (such as Wi-Fi).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Switch the network connection off.
  2. Change the as-of date to yesterday.
  3. Switch the network back on.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The computer is offline.

Step 2:

  • The report fails to load: "Something went wrong loading this report. Please try again." shows in place of the rows.
  • The standard error message shows as well.

Step 3:

  • The connection is back.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • User Feedback Summary: “Report fails to load | "Something went wrong loading this report. Please try again." | In place of the rows, plus the standard error toast”
